sentences.text:
Kupram Kaluram Choudhary vs State Of Maharashtra on 23
June, 2022

Bench: N. J. Jamadar
 16-Aba3102-21.Doc
 Santosh
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Anticipatory Bail Application No. 3102 Of 2021
Kupram Kaluram Choudhary ...Applicant
 Versus
State of Maharashtra ...Respondent

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Mr. Avinash Patil, for the Applicant.
Mr. P. H. Gaikwad, App for the State.

Mr. Dnyaneshwar Mule, P.I., Chatushringi Police Station,
 present.

Coram: N. J. Jamadar, J.
 Dated : 23rd June, 2022
Pc:-
1. Heard the learned Counsel for the applicant and the learned APP for the State.

2. This application is preferred for pre-arrest bail in connection with CR No.61 of 2021, registered with Chaturshringi Police Station, for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273 and 328 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 ("the Penal Code") and Sections 30(2)(a), 26(2)(i) and 26(2)(iv) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
3. By an order dated 22nd December, 2021, this Court was persuaded to grant interim pre-arrest bail.
In the intervening period, investigation is complete and charge-sheet has been 16-ABA3102-21.DOC lodged on 4th March, 2022.
It appears that pursuant to the orders passed by this Court, on 15 th January, 2022 the applicant was arrested and released on bail.

4. In the aforesaid view of the matter, the application for pre- arrest, having served its purpose,
stands disposed.
